program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((seeds (filter (lambda (cell) (not (member (third cell) (list 0 5))))
                       (grid-cells g))))
    (define (dist seed r c) (+ (abs (- (first seed) r)) (abs (- (second seed) c))))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (not (= (at g r c) 0))
            (at g r c)
            (let* ((best (apply min (map (lambda (seed) (dist seed r c)) seeds)))
                   (hits (filter (lambda (seed) (= (dist seed r c) best)) seeds)))
              (if (= (length hits) 1) (third (first hits)) 8)))))))
